name: Analog Rytm
summary: OS 1.73 and 1.74 formats documented and rebuilt byte-identical; modified 1.73 and a from-source 1.74 replacement OS boot on hardware; stock recovers both over MIDI DIN.

firmware.flash: Elektron Transfer over USB: set MIDI IN and OUT to the device, drop the .syx on and press YES on the device. It restarts by itself.
firmware.recovery: Recovery mode is MIDI DIN ONLY — it does NOT work over USB: the startup menu never enumerates USB, so once a non-stock OS is on the unit a MIDI-DIN sender is REQUIRED (a USB-MIDI interface, or a hand-wired FT232RL serial adapter at 31250 baud: +5V/220 ohm to DIN 4, TXD/220 ohm to DIN 5, GND to DIN 2, raw .syx). Hold FUNC at power-on, TRIG 4 (OS UPGRADE), send the owner's stock .syx.

research.label: rytm-fw-re
research.note: Static analysis of OS 1.74: format, boot contract, startup-menu recovery, display pipeline, plus a from-source replacement OS. Hardware-verified: flashed over USB, booted (display + memory probe), recovered to stock 1.74 over MIDI DIN via a hand-wired FT232RL adapter. No firmware hosted.

research.label: elektron-firmware-tool
research.note: Writer. Verified on OS 1.74: unchanged repack is byte-identical to the stock file (sysex re-encode and aPLib recompression included); section replacement round-trips exactly on re-extract.

research.label: rytm-mods-src
research.note: MrScruff's OS 1.73 mod build, published with permission. make verify rebuilds the stock .syx byte for byte and asserts that only MAIN OS changes; eight of its twelve mods are marked hardware-verified by their author. No firmware hosted.

research.label: rytm-mods-boot-report
research.note: Stock OS 1.73 .syx rebuilt byte-identical by elektron-firmware-tool (matching SHA-256). A build of rytm-mods-src cf5ac006 then booted on an MKII with 0008-filter-hz working, and the stock .syx restored it. Also shows 1.74 to 1.73 over USB and DIN. Hashes and photos only.
